summary.description: One short paragraph. MUST begin with the load indicator 'Policy loaded: N rule files from jbaruch/coding-policy.' where N is the count of rules/*.md files read.

findings.description: One entry per substantiated finding or useful advisory suggestion on a changed line; optional hardening claims no binding violation. Empty when there are no findings.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the changed file.

line.description: 1-indexed line in the file the finding anchors to.

rule.description: The governing rule file, e.g. 'ci-safety'; for optional hardening, the classification rule rather than a claim of violation.

severity.description: blocking for a substantiated material defect or an unmet binding obligation affecting meaning or behavior; advisory for optional hardening and presentation changes. A proposed fix changing behavior alone never establishes a blocker. See review-severity.

message.description: Category prefix ([defect], [policy mismatch] or [optional hardening]), evidence, binding clause when applicable, and smallest sufficient remedy.
